'''Chapter 373''' is called "Necessary Evil".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: Under a summer shower, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Sanji]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], and [[Nami]] stand in elaborate {{W|Yukata|yukatas}}, wielding oil-paper parasols along with a combination of [[sword]]s and [[firearm]]s. Behind them, a row of frogs are singing.

(The {{nihongo|[[wiktionary:花道#Etymology_2|"Hanamichi"]]|花道}} legend implies a deliberate ''{{W|Kabuki}}'' homage.)

==Short Summary==
Those on the [[Puffing Tom]] attempt to escape the [[CP9]].

==Long Summary==
[[Franky]] is seen falling off the roof of the [[Puffing Tom]] injured by [[Nero]] who has taken advantage of his weakness. As he begins to mock Franky who is holding on to the side of the train, he is tricked and his arms and legs are locked down by Franky who smashes him through the roof of the third car. There, he meets with [[Sanji]] and the [[CP9]] who are all now onto their feet.

[[Kaku]] explains that Nero is the new member of CP9 as he gets up onto his feet. At this, [[Rob Lucci]] gravely injures Nero explaining that he was too weak since he only knew four of the forms. Lucci continues to explain that it is worthless trying to save [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and reveals that the reason she was given such a bounty at a young age was due to the fact she has the ability to wake one of the [[Ancient Weapons]].

Angered by this, Sanji attacks Lucci just as Robin enters the room with [[Usopp|Sogeking]] having defeated [[Corgi]]. Sanji happily questions her on how she is while Franky notes that she looks like the girl in the bounty. However, she throws Sogeking stating how her words appear meaningless to them. Just then, Sogeking declares to Franky to detach the third car as he throws a smoke star as he grabs Robin and the four make their escape.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Franky]] defeats [[Nero]], sending him crashing through the roof of the [[Puffing Tom]] where [[CP9]], [[Sanji]] and an unconscious [[Wanze]] are.
*[[Kaku]] reveals that Nero is a new member of CP9 who only has four of the [[Six Powers]] mastered.
*[[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] kills Nero for being too weak.
*[[Sanji]] angrily attacks Lucci for speaking ill on [[Nico Robin|Robin]].
*Robin, despite [[Usopp|Sogeking]]'s pleas not to, enters the 2nd car.
*Franky meets Robin face-to-face for the first time.
*Robin seems to be adamant on not wanting to be rescued.
*Sogeking tells Franky to cut the 3rd car loose as he throws a smoke bomb to disorient CP9 and grabs Robin.
